events.verdict: Prince (MIL) fails to establish a legal position outside the RA while defending the drive to the basket and shot attempt by Burks (MIA).
Antetokounmpo (MIA) does not brings his hand under the ball along the perimeter.
Burks (MIA) contests the shot and initiates contact with Green's (MIL) body, affecting the jump shot attempt.
As the pick dissolves, Green (MIL) moves into and makes marginal contact with Adebayo (MIA) along the perimeter.
Adebayo (MIA) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) engage and disengage with one another during the rebound.
Green (MIL) makes marginal contact with Burks (MIA) as he moves along the perimeter prior to the pick.
Prince (MIL) rotates over and initiates contact with Anderson's (MIA) arm, which affects his play at the basket. Although Prince maintains his verticality, his body drifts A to B.
Adebayo (MIA) brushes Lopez's (MIL) arm and marginal contact occurs during Lopez's (MIL) shot attempt near the rim.
Porter Jr. (MIL) is moving alongside Mitchell's (MIA) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
While defending the entry pass, Adebayo (MIA) briefly engages with Antetokounmpo (MIL) on the elbow and cleanly deflects the basketball on the play.

Replay review of the foul called on Mitchell (MIA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Mitchell moves laterally into Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and initiates body contact that affects Antetokounmpo's SQBR during the drive. This illegal contact precedes the whistle hook by Antetokounmpo.
Green (MIL) and Larsson (MIA) make incidental contact with one another while in the pursuit of the pass at the start of transition.
Porter Jr. (MIL) gets wide and intentionally kicks the ball while defending the pass.
Porter Jr. (MIL) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
After absorbing the oncoming contact, Adebayo (MIA) places his and on Antetokounmpo's (MIL) side without extending or applying pressure during the shot attempt.
After the rebound is secured, Adebayo (MIA) attempts to tie the ball up further but is thwarted by Lopez (MIL) who releases the pass to his teammate.
Anderson (MIA) makes incidental arm contact with Porter Jr. (MIL) as he splits the pick. The ball becomes loose after it bounces off Lopez's (MIL) foot.
Lopez (MIL) is firming up when he makes contact with Porter Jr. (MIL) on the pick.
Robinson (MIA) jumps alongside Porter Jr. (MIL) and briefly grabs Porter Jr.'s (MIL) jersey during his shot attempt at the rim.
Adebayo (MIA) makes marginal contact with Porter Jr. (MIL) while setting the screen during the inbound play. Any contact between Adebayo and Antetokounmpo (MIL) is considered mutually marginal.
Robinson (MIA) maintains his pivot foot after receiving the entry pass.
While moving into a screening position, Lopez (MIL) extends his arms into Larsson's (MIA) head and dislodges him from his defensive position.
The first illegal contact from Prince (MIL) occurs prior to Burks (MIA) upward shooting motion. The whistle was correctly assessed as on the floor.
